title: Refresh: CPS-v3 v3 panel/derived + Hazard/Gate recompute (post +10)
abstract: Re-ingests +10 for CPS-v3, exports panel/derived, and recomputes hazard (with resolution) and v0.3.1 cross-layer gate.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.recovery_decay_analysis import compute_recovery_decay
from meta.sas.tools.export_recovery_decay_panel import export_panel
from meta.sas.tools.export_recovery_hazard import export as export_hazard
from meta.sas.tools.export_cross_layer_gate import export as export_gate
try:
  from meta.sas.tools.export_dashboard_state import export_dashboard_state
except Exception:
  export_dashboard_state = None

DER = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json'
PAN = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/recovery_decay_zephyr_iv_v3.json'

out = {}
out['derived'] = compute_recovery_decay(agent='Zephyr IV',
                                        dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
                                        out_path=DER,
                                        experiments=['cps_v3'])
out['panel'] = export_panel(in_path=DER, out_path=PAN)
out['hazard'] = export_hazard(in_path=DER,
                              out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_hazard_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json')
out['gate'] = export_gate(in_path=DER,
                          out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/cross_layer_gate_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json')
out['dashboard_state'] = export_dashboard_state() if export_dashboard_state else {"skipped": True}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
